title: G-1450 — Authorization for Credit Card Transactions

g1450_sobrenome.label: Last name of the applicant, petitioner, or requester

g1450_nome.label: First name of the applicant, petitioner, or requester

g1450_titular_sobrenome.label: Cardholder's last name (as it appears on the card)
g1450_titular_sobrenome.hint: Can be different from the applicant — for example, when a family member pays the fee.

g1450_endereco_tipo.label: Unit type in the billing address

g1450_valor_autorizado.label: Authorized payment amount (in dollars, no cents)
g1450_valor_autorizado.hint: Double-check the exact fee amount before filling this in — it's what will be charged to the card.
